title: Would anyone be told when Custom Preset Ranges gives up on a thermostat?
task: Nightly run. Check whether the HVAC Custom Preset Ranges (S10) 'gave up' notifications actually reach the operator. Diagnose with evidence, act within tiers, submit a report.
context_pack: S10 latches after 3 unconfirmed writes or 3 failures on a zone/preset and stops trying; it then sends a Notification Manager (NM) message.
NM delivers by severity according to its channel config; rows that qualify for no channel are logged as audit rows.

response.excerpt_summary: _s10_latch(...) calls self._s10_notify(hazard_type=<'s10_restore_not_taking' | 's10_preset_range_call_failed' | 's10_preset_range_not_sticking'>, severity='MEDIUM', ...). _s10_notify(hazard_type, severity, message) (hvac.py:4451) forwards severity to NM async_notify. 's10_restore_pending' is sent at LOW. The latched flag is persisted so one NM per latch.
